title: Frigid Manipulations
subtitle: Congeatio - blood remembers cold
text: The Frigid temper belongs to blood that has congealed, not from death, but from exposure to deep cold. Glacial Grasp (QUICK) freezes source water along an aimed path and lays Rime on wet targets. Sculpting, Projection: held on open water it freezes a path under the stream that melts back after ten seconds, and held on a creature it closes a hand of ice on it: the hand forms over a second and holds the creature where it stands, and a click squeezes harder the longer it held. Sculpting, Absorption: held on Frozen Cruor or ice it thaws it back to water. Cryogenic Pulse (QUICK) releases a cold pulse that builds Rime round you. Glacial Rampart (QUICK) raises an aimed ice wall, or a shell round you while you crouch. Sculpting, Projection: swept along the ground it raises a wall three high wherever the stream passes, and never closes it over anyone standing there. Cruor Javelin (QUICK) hurls a shaft of frozen cruor, and held it is drawn into the hand through three stages and thrown when you let go; it breaks on a body and sticks in a block, where your Absorption takes half its blood back. Crystalline Bloom (QUICK) crystallizes the blood of every enemy within six blocks. Rimebound Sentence (CHARGED) deals charged frost damage and encloses a fully charged target. Absolute Stillness (CONTINUOUS) channels a field that slows projectiles and smothers fire. Endless Hour (QUICK) is Velorum's Canon Memory: it holds a killing blow off for ten still seconds. Conjure Flail reshapes a held Living Staff into a Living Flail. The Frigid practitioner is a defensive one. Cold blood does not rush.
